question: Should this workflow be authorized to mint repository-scoped GitHub App tokens, reconcile the crawl-remote Cloudflare Access application and policy, and publish generation-bound credentials across the two repositories before the slot-aware consumer lands?
rationale: The implementation can be reviewed mechanically, but only a maintainer with operational knowledge can confirm the intended GitHub App installation scope, Cloudflare account authority, named-operator binding, and acceptable staging sequence.

options.title: Approve after controlled proof
options.body: Approve the dormant bootstrap after validating the live App permissions and reviewing a redacted non-rotation or staged reconciliation transcript that confirms the exact targets and fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Hold for atomic cutover
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the slot-aware consumer and migration are ready to land together, avoiding an independently deployed privileged staging workflow.
